:::{#def-cv-se}
#### Fold-based standard error

The **fold-based standard error** $\cvse{\nfolds}$
of a $\nfolds$-fold [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
is the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd)
of the $\nfolds$ [fold sMSEs](#def-fold-mse),
divided by $\sqrt{\nfolds}$:

$$
\cvse{\nfolds} \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmse{1}, \ldots, \foldmse{\nfolds}}}{\sqrt{\nfolds}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se}

:::
